name: Alice
text: Morning all — heads up that the client call moved to 3:30, so bring the updated deck to the small room if you can join. Alice

name: Linarello
text: Does anyone know where the spare dongles went? Second floor lost three this week, and the new starters are still waiting on the replacements to be booked in, so ping Linarello if you spot them.

name: Niara Hayla Bertling
text: Quick reminder that the studio is booked for the whole afternoon, so keep the hallway clear until the shoot wraps. The delivery crew also wants the side door unlocked at noon so they can stage the crates. If anything slips, Niara Hayla Bertling is covering the desk until six.

name: Uthayakumari Semialj
text: Panel three is down again, so keep the pending tickets on hold until the sparky shows up today. Uthayakumari Semialj

name: Jina
text: The break room fridge gets cleaned Friday, so label anything you want to keep. Unlabeled tubs go in the bin, and that includes the mystery curry from last month, sorry Jina.

name: Nguy
text: Reminder that the loading bay door sticks in cold weather, so give it a firm pull. The courier arrives at seven with the lab order. If the buzzer does not sound, ring the office and someone will come down, otherwise Nguy gets a pile of missed slips again.

name: de Rama
text: Team, the quiet room is booked until four today, so please take your calls in the pod instead. de Rama

name: Kilián Velu
text: Anyone free to swap the closing shift? I have a dentist appointment at five and the bus after it is unreliable. Post here if you can, otherwise Kilián Velu will juggle both.

name: Gionni
text: Heads up that the vending machine refund guy comes Thursday, so keep the failed purchase receipts. The card reader is a separate queue, and the snack guy said the chip slot is on backorder for weeks. If yours ate a note, drop the serial in this thread, otherwise Gionni will log it with the office.

name: Sikila
text: Water is off in the east wing until noon, so use the kitchen taps downstairs or the ones by reception. Sikila

name: Abi Aad
text: Bike shed keys are back on the hook by the mail room. Sign the sheet if you take them out, because the last set went missing for a week. Abi Aad

name: Jeznach Iob
text: Please stop parking in bay six. It is reserved for the courier and the van got blocked twice this week. The barrier code changes Monday morning, so update your saved notes before then, and ask Jeznach Iob if the old code stops working at the gate.

name: Pimpão
text: Fire drill moved to 2pm, and the meeting point is still the far end of the north car park. Pimpão

name: Jelte
text: Dental cleaning Thursday at 11:15 with the new hygienist. Arrive ten minutes early for the paperwork, and bring the insurance card that was missing last time, plus the referral letter. Jelte

name: Khanfir
text: Physio session for the shoulder moved to Wednesday at 4:40 in the annex. Parking is tight, so use the side lot behind the annex. Wear loose clothing and bring the exercise band from home. The clinic asked for the referral to be emailed ahead, so forward it tonight if possible. Khanfir

name: Tijn Kolata Zoch
text: Allergy shot Friday at 9:20 in room 3B. No food for two hours before, and bring the antihistamine list. Tijn Kolata Zoch

name: Denniz Ebin
text: Eye test Tuesday at 2:10, the optician is on the second floor above the bakery. Take the old glasses along, even the scratched pair, because they compare lens thickness. Denniz Ebin

name: Khashayar
text: Parent teacher meeting moved to Thursday at 5:30 in the library, entry through the side gate by the gym. The teacher asked for the reading log to be signed before then. Slots run twenty minutes each, so arrive early if you want to speak first. Khashayar

name: Bekhechi
text: Boiler service Wednesday between 8 and 12. Clear the cupboard under the sink so the engineer can reach the valve. Bekhechi

name: Tasanee Gugacoska Avmeti
text: Scan at the imaging center, Monday 8:40, fasting from midnight. Check in at the desk by the ambulance bay and mention the referral number, then wait in the blue chairs area. Tasanee Gugacoska Avmeti

name: Olgitsa Sirmali
text: Hearing test Thursday at 3 at the audiology clinic on Rose Street across from the old post office. Take the noise exposure form if the office gave you one, the audiologist reviews it first. The booth is on the second floor, so take the lift by the pharmacy. Olgitsa Sirmali

name: Stavri
text: Flu jab Saturday morning at the pop up in the market square. Bring the blue card and wear a short sleeve. Stavri

name: Ursulovic
text: Car service Friday, drop it at seven so the courtesy van is free for the school run. The garage confirmed the loaner today. Remove the barrier fobs and the parking pass from the glovebox tonight. Ursulovic

name: Coleen Patricie
text: Vaccination booster for the trip, Tuesday at 4 in the travel clinic near the station, entrance on the side street. Bring the yellow booklet and the list of current meds. The nurse said to skip the morning dose that day and drink plenty of water, so set an alarm. Coleen Patricie

name: von Niessen
text: Viewing at the flat on Mill Lane moved to Sunday at noon. Meet the agent by the front gate. von Niessen

name: Howlett
text: Annual review with the bank advisor, Thursday 10:30, branch on High Street next to the bakery. The advisor wants the mortgage statement from last year, and proof of the salary raise. Howlett

name: Biagina
text:
Quick one before the weekend: the shared drive is read only until the migration finishes, so save locally if you are editing. The vendor support window starts at nine and should last an hour. Apologies for the short notice again, we only got the slot this morning.
Thanks,
Biagina

name: Schmöller
text:
Cold water tap in the kitchen is fine now, the valve got swapped this afternoon while the kitchen was closed.
Thanks,
Schmöller

name: Utanç Paoletto Kubíková
text:
Server room visit moved to tomorrow, the badge reader is being replaced today. Park in the visitor spot and sign in at the gatehouse. Bring the asset tags from last time.
Best regards,
Utanç Paoletto Kubíková

name: Middel Hallen Dichri
text:
Roof inspection booked for Tuesday, they need the skylight keys for the north side. The keys live in the drawer marked site, second one down. Please leave them on the hook by Friday so the crew is not delayed. The invoice goes to the facilities mailbox as usual.
Regards,
Middel Hallen Dichri

name: Leonita
text:
Quiet room clock is twenty minutes fast, so ignore the corner display when you book the next slot.
Cheers,
Leonita

name: Altevogt
text:
Printer on floor two is out of staple cartridges again. The order was marked delivered but nothing arrived, so I have reopened the ticket with the supplier. It shows as signed for at the gate.
Thanks,
Altevogt

name: Grässer Korkia
text:
Bin collection moves to Wednesday next week because of the roadworks on the estate road. Please put the bins out by seven, the lorry will not wait. If yours was missed last time, log it with the council. Collections catch up on Saturday.
Kind regards,
Grässer Korkia

name: Al Lahib
text:
Meeting room 2 projector is fixed, the cable was the culprit all along, not the lamp after all.
Best,
Al Lahib

name: Marlei
text:
Shuttle timetable changes Monday, the early run now leaves at ten past six. The late run is unchanged, so only a few of us are affected. The driver confirmed the new times.
Cheers,
Marlei

name: Ghiglia
text:
Cold snap is coming, so the workshop heaters are being serviced this week ahead of the frost. If yours rattles or blows cold, log it before Friday so the contractor brings the right parts. Blankets are in the blue locker as a stopgap. Do not use the old fan heaters.
Thanks,
Ghiglia

name: Koyilar Verdillon Santacroce
text:
Lift inspection passed, the car is back in service as of this morning with a new certificate on the wall.
Regards,
Koyilar Verdillon Santacroce

name: Seiller Arabia Rinnhofer
text:
Rota for the open day is on the wall. Two slots on the welcome table still need names, otherwise the office pulls people from the back. Put your name down today.
Thanks,
Seiller Arabia Rinnhofer

name: Grace
text:
Reminder for the midwife appointment, Wednesday at 10:20 in the community hub. Take the maternity notes and the urine sample bottle from the fridge. Parking behind the hub is free for an hour, so aim to arrive by ten. The reception asked us to confirm the slot by text.
Thanks,
Grace

name: Ginat
text:
Podiatry visit Thursday 1:30 in the annex, bring the shoe inserts for review and the old prescription. It should take half an hour.
Thanks,
Ginat

name: Teck Ajrullahi Gürdere
text:
Ultrasound Tuesday at 3:40, radiology wing, first floor. Drink water an hour before and do not empty your bladder. Check in fifteen minutes early. The referral is already on file.
Regards,
Teck Ajrullahi Gürdere

name: Pahwa Zerla
text:
Annual asthma review Thursday at 11, room above the pharmacy. Take both inhalers and the peak flow diary from the kitchen drawer. The nurse will redo the breathing test, so skip the morning workout. The practice sent a text to confirm the slot.
Kind regards,
Pahwa Zerla

name: Navjot
text:
Blood test moved to Friday 8:10, first floor, no fasting needed this time. Take the yellow referral form.
Thanks,
Navjot

name: Takaki
text:
Chimney sweep confirmed for Monday between 9 and 1. Please clear the fireplace and move the logs to the yard. The van needs the driveway clear. He will ring the bell before starting.
Regards,
Takaki

name: Beytül Supakorn
text:
Colonoscopy prep starts Wednesday, two sachets from the pharmacy, one at six and one at eight. No solid food after lunch and only clear drinks. The unit will call to confirm the arrival time on Tuesday. Take the whole day off work.
Best regards,
Beytül Supakorn

name: Akinobu Vasyl
text:
Deep clean at the dentist moved to Monday 9:40, bring the mouthguard and the full sensitivity list.
Thanks,
Akinobu Vasyl

name: Aruni
text:
Boiler service visit Wednesday at eight, the engineer needs the cupboard cleared. Last time the flue reading was borderline, so allow extra time. The landlord pays the invoice directly.
Thanks,
Aruni

name: Rashidian
text:
Curtain fitting Thursday afternoon, the fitter asked for the old rails to stay up until he arrives. Move the sofa away from the bay window and clear the sill. Parking permit is in the kitchen drawer. The new tracks are already in the hallway.
Regards,
Rashidian

name: Carizzoni Squillante
text:
Piano tuning Friday 3pm, please keep the room quiet for an hour and leave the windows shut.
Thanks,
Carizzoni Squillante

name: Joenna Jennet Eales
text:
Vegetable box delivery switches to Saturday morning, the driver will leave it by the shed. If you are out, he texts a photo. Cancel the weekday slot when you get a chance.
Thanks,
Joenna Jennet Eales
